about: lev_4_m2 peasant rescue: Roman warped on the ground 30 units east of peasant 291 (peasant_man at (130, -187, 117.7)), facing +x, walks backwards (S) past him and onto door mat 314 (one_shot, on_enter 7000 = peasant_saved_trigger) at (70, -197). The peasant is captured when Roman's body meets his trigger sphere (0x00406210; the sphere of sphere_radius 20 centred 20 above him, 0x004574e0: original frame 52, 16.7 units off), tied as a ragdoll on the rope (0x00405d10: the rope takes the distance, reels in at 5 units / s to 3; the pelvis is pulled when beyond it), and banked at the mat (MissionObject_OnTrigger 0x0044d600: saved 1 at frame 160, the peasant and the one-shot mat killed, ui_peasant_release). Ends at 200, after the bank (the gunners' fight after that is the grunts' business)
